Subject: Ironvale Logistics - Quote Request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Ironvale Logistics! I've reviewed the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary commodities stored/handled at each location?
- What are the construction types and protection classes for all three facilities?
- Are there any high-hazard operations (e.g., hazmat storage, refrigeration)?
- Any planned changes to operations or expansions in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive proposal for you.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
